description: This file provides a safe API for operating on /proc on Linux, including functions to open and manage procfs handles, especially for thread-specific and root operations, with safety considerations for kernel versions and security vulnerabilities.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A wrapper around an *os.File handle to /proc, providing methods for safe and unsafe access to /proc filesystem.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the procfs handle, releasing resources.

methods.name: OpenProcRoot
methods.description: Opens a safe handle to /proc with subset=pid mount option if available.

methods.name: OpenUnsafeProcRoot
methods.description: Opens an unsafe handle to /proc without overmounts or masked paths.

methods.name: OpenThreadSelf
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/thread-self/<subpath> for the current thread.

methods.name: OpenRoot
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/<subpath> for global procfs files.

methods.name: OpenPid
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/<pid>/<subpath> for other processes.
